name: Russia–Ukraine
summary: Russian bombs kill 26 at an aid point in Zaporizhzhia on 2 Nov; strikes cut power in 10 regions
state: Russian aerial bombs hit a school used as a shelter and aid point in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia region, on 2 Nov, killing 26 people, according to Zelensky and Ukraine's emergency services (AP). Russia launched 759 drones on 1 Nov and 193 overnight into 2 Nov, cutting power in 10 regions (Kyiv Independent). A local truce in Kherson region ended on 1 Nov; Zelensky hopes for US–Russia–Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi from 6–10 Nov.
for_you: Travel to Ukraine is against FCDO advice. Energy and grain markets remain sensitive to the war.
rubric_hit: Mass strikes on energy infrastructure causing multi-region blackouts = Alert
